items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Wallace took lessons from a German professor... Wallace Davenport took lessons from a German professor.

ctx.x: Well, the schools in her day, you know.

Wallace took lessons from a German professor. Who did? They were still walking around here. In the 30's, because Wallace Davenport. Oh yeah. The German used to come over to the Wallace house with his little briefcase and teach Wallace. Wallace Davenport took lessons from a German professor. When you came to town, where did you move to? Down, two blocks down, first in Denia. 1925 up until about 1932 then I moved. I've been here for some years.
